verdict.rationale: Stagehand's core primitives take plain-English instructions: act() executes natural-language actions with no selectors, extract() takes an instruction, observe() discovers actions, and the MCP integration controls browsers with commands like "click the login button". Community users corroborate the natural-language, self-healing abstraction. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of how reliably the natural-language commands work, and clarity that high-level autonomous agent tasking is documented for v3 while v4 has no autonomous loop.
